sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns the last successfully loaded HEAD.
sites.justification: Recent commits are refetched only when HEAD changes or a previous history read failed, preventing index-only refresh flicker.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns its transient retry flag.
sites.justification: A failed recent-commits read must self-heal on the next successful status refresh without refetching on every index-only update.

sites.ownership: The project sidebar owns a shared programmatic-position guard.
sites.justification: Animated GtkPaned position updates must bypass drag clamping in both directions while user drag input can still cancel the animation.
